title: Unit Event — The Phoenix in the Distant Sky — Episode6 The Distant Peak

meta.Event: The Phoenix in the Distant Sky
meta.Event Outline: At the Otoris' suggestion, Tsukasa and the rest of WxS are set to perform in the Phoenix Stage's 30th Anniversary Show. What's more, they'll be performing a show starred in by Tsukasa's idol. Tsukasa leaps at the chance to audition for the same role as him!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Aye aye, sir!
Rui, can I power it up now?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes. The time has come for the bird robot I made for our shows to rise once more...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Chasing around a flying robot...
Do you really think this is going to be good practice, Tsukasa...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: He said the idea is based on the advice he received from Seiryuin... And I think it should prove effective.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Rio has to chase the phoenix around for a large portion of the show, so I figured that I should try doing that for as long as I can! That may give me some new insights!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Ah, it's up!
Time to catch you!!!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Grr...!
The way it moves is so unpredictable...!

rows.Speaker: Robo-Phoenix
rows.Line:
“Oh, done already...?
You sounded so confident about catching me just now.”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: It's a recording of my voice.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: The phoenix taunts Rio as he chases after her, no? I thought this would help make it feel more real.

rows.Speaker: Robo-Phoenix
rows.Line:
“Too slow.
Honestly, where are you looking? Are you not going to catch me?”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
(Rio's an eight-year-old boy...
Also, he's not very athletic and only has his favorite bug-catching net at his disposal.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (With that in mind, catching a phoenix sounds absolutely impossible. However...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (His mother's life depends on him succeeding right now...!)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
“Stop!
I'm going to catch you no matter what!”

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Are you okay, Tsukasa?
You fell a whole lot...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I'm fine. Rio also falls quite a lot.
Also, I'm being careful not to actually get hurt.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I know we don't have much time, but try not to push yourself too hard, okay? Here, use this bandage.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
But...
I still haven't quite figured Rio out yet...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I may not have actually made a connection with him yet. I mean, we're not in a forest, and the temperature and humidity feel completely different...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Alas, I know that I can't ask for everything. We don't have time to visit a forest since we need to practice, so...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Rio spends three days and nights surviving only on water...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Then, I shall do the same.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: B-But... We're still practicing every day, and you have to play the chicken, remember? Just water? Are you sure...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I fear that I won't be able to become Rio if I don't...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
...
Your resolve is admirable, Tsukasa, and I don't plan to get in the way of you becoming a star.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: However, I will stop you if I believe you're taking things too far.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Okay, thank you.
Especially since there would be a negative impact on the show if I were to fall ill.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But... Until then, I'm going to push myself to the limit!

rows.Speaker: Cast Member A
rows.Line:
Tenma, you're slowing down!
Try to keep up!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Grr... I'd be able to keep running if only I were at full strength...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh no!
Tsukasa, you're really wobbly! Are you sure you're okay?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
S-Sorry, Emu.
I feel a little lightheaded since I haven't had anything to eat...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: At the same time, I think I'm starting to understand how hard it is to move while in a state of severe hunger...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But I'm also supposed to have wandered into an unfamiliar land. Oh, I can try remembering what it was like when we were stranded on that desert island...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “I... I thought I had you this time!”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
“Why can't I catch you...?
Why am I so weak and powerless...?”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
No, that doesn't sound right...
He's feeling more than just sorrow here...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: He's doing better than before, but...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: He feels that he's still missing something...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (I'm trying to express how he truly feels, but...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (I still haven't brought Rio to life...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (As much as I want to figure it out, I don't have time... At this rate...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
No...!
I absolutely don't have time to think about that. I need to act! Now!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Do not give up, Tsukasa Tenma!
I know you can do it...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
“Why can't I catch you...?
Why am I so weak and powerless...?”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “I'm doing everything I can to catch you, but all you do is taunt and tease me!”

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: “The way you have been chasing me around so persistently... A very small part of me actually admires you...”

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: “Regardless of all the pain you are feeling, you still wish to save your mother?”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
“I do...
Which is why I need to take your heart back to her...!”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Performing opposite Seiryuin inevitably leads to my character sounding artificial... No, more than that...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: She feels even more like a phoenix now...

rows.Speaker: Cast Member A
rows.Line: I'll be in this next scene!

rows.Speaker: Cast Member A
rows.Line:
“Wh-What am I supposed to do...?
I want to save my mom, but...”

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (The others are beginning to distinguish themselves from one another as Seiryuin pulls them along...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (None seem to be the clear favorite, but at this rate, Tsukasa...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Not only will he not be able to reach Seiryuin's level, just getting the role is going to be a struggle...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
(Each Rio has its qualities...
They're all doing an excellent job of showing how frustrated he feels being unable to catch the phoenix despite his best efforts.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
(I only have two days left...
What can I do...?!)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Do I need to start observing what the others are doing in order to win this part...?)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (I'll surely be selected if I can show that my portrayal is even marginally better.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (And after I'm chosen, I may be given more opportunities to polish what I have as we practice.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Which means, first and foremost, I need to come up with a way to win this audition...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: There's no point in winning this part with such a cheap portrayal.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Because the kind of star I want to become is...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (I've thought about my character's background, how he feels, how he acts and moves... So many times too.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (I'm nowhere near Seiryuin's level, or the others for that matter.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (There's just no end to it, is there...?)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (The shows we've done at the Wonder Stage, our ambassadorial performances, that show we did with Asahi and his troupe, the workshop I attended...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (I clearly felt that I grew and made big steps each time I stood on stage.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Which is why I thought the same would apply for this show. I was convinced that I'd be able to keep growing.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (There are plenty of others just like me out there.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Not only that, great actors and incredible talent like Asahi and Seiryuin exist...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
(He's on top of the world.
Somewhere so distant and unfathomable...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
How can I reach that place?
What do I need to do exactly...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You won't be able to reach it if you don't extend your hand. You won't achieve anything...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Who could that be? It's so late...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What are you all doing here so late...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: We're really sorry, Tsukasa, but we thought this was our only chance!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Yeah...
There isn't much time left until the audition...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
But we've come this far.
So, why don't we think about it together?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: A way for you to fully capture Rio.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
(Now I see...
I kept trying to figure this all out on my own, but...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (It takes more than one person to put on a show.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (I've been able to reach some great heights already because I've had them here with me...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (The chances of the current me succeeding at this are exceedingly slim...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
(I'm not about to stop here...
Not while I have their support.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (As someone who's destined to become a future star...!)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Until the day of the audition, let's do our best together!!!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Now...?!
You couldn't have picked a worse time...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hehe. It just means you're aching for a bite, right? Make sure to eat something tomorrow so that you'll be ready to practice at full strength.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, I'll bring a really big rice ball!!!
